meta.name: ai-voice-cloning
meta.description: AI voice generation, text-to-speech, and voice synthesis via inference.sh CLI. Models: Kokoro TTS, DIA, Chatterbox, Higgs, VibeVoice for natural speech. Capabilities: multiple voices, emotions, accents, long-form narration, conversation. Use for: voiceovers, audiobooks, podcasts, video narration, accessibility. Triggers: voice cloning, tts, text to speech, ai voice, voice generation, voice synthesis, voice over, narration, speech synthesis, ai narrator, elevenlabs alternative, natural voice, realistic speech, voice ai

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文字转成自然语音，用于配音和旁白
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为视频、播客或有声书生成语音
copy.tagline_en: Turn text into natural-sounding voice for narration and voiceovers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate speech for videos, podcasts, or audiobooks

howto.what: 通过 infsh 命令行调用文本转语音模型,把文字变成语音音频文件。支持选不同声音(性别、风格、英美口音)、调语速,还能合并多段对话或给视频配旁白。
howto.when: 当你提到 voice cloning、tts、text to speech 等关键词,或要求给视频配音、制作有声书、播客音频时触发。

say.text: 把这段文字转成语音:'欢迎收听本期节目',用女声
say.note: 调用 Kokoro TTS 生成对应音频

say.text: 用英式男声、慢速朗读这段小说开头
say.note: 指定英音男声并调低语速

say.text: 把这两句话分别用男女声生成,再合并成对话
say.note: 走多说话人对话合并流程

howto.what_en: Via the infsh CLI, converts text to speech audio files using TTS models. Supports voice selection (gender, style, US/UK accent), speed control, merging multi-speaker dialogue, and adding narration to video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords such as voice cloning, tts, or text to speech, or ask for video narration, audiobook, or podcast audio.

say_en.text: Turn this text into speech: 'Welcome to our show,' female voice.
say_en.note: Calls Kokoro TTS to synthesize audio.

say_en.text: Narrate this novel passage with a British male voice, slow speed.
say_en.note: Uses a British male voice at slower speed.

say_en.text: Generate these two lines with male and female voices, then merge.
